title: Mt. Kailash, Tibet
author: NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS, and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team
description: This image from NASA Terra spacecraft shows Mt. Kailash, a peak in the Kailas Range in Tibet. It lies near the source of some of the longest Asian rivers: the Brahmaputra, the Sutlej and the Karnali.
